read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 45% on incretins; 2025 guide of $58-61B (about 32% growth at midpoint) assumes net prices fall mid-to-high single digits, while capacity is 1.6x H1 incretin doses.

utilisation.quote: The company met its production goal, delivering 1.5x the incretin salable doses in the second half of 2024 versus the same period in 2023.

capex.peers_comment: Management referenced the competitor's capacity build-out, and said it also gates injectable supply to match demand.
capex.quote: we're building facilities as fast as we can to match up those 2 things, what we can make and what we can sell

triggers.label: Incretin doses 1.5x H2 2024 vs H2 2023
triggers.quote: delivering on our production target to make 1.5x the salable doses of incretin medicines in the second half of '24 compared to the second half of '23

triggers.label: Net prices down mid-to-high single digits in 2025
triggers.quote: we forecast overall net prices to decline by mid- to high single digits in percentage terms, including U.S. Part D changes

triggers.label: 2025 revenue $58-61B, ~32% growth at midpoint
triggers.quote: we expect 2025 revenue to be between $58 million and $61 billion. The midpoint represents approximately 32% growth

triggers.label: Zepbound leads anti-obesity new scripts
triggers.quote: In Q4, Zepbound became the market leader in the anti-obesity market as measured by new prescriptions.

guidance.quote: we expect 2025 revenue to be between $58 million and $61 billion.
Earnings per share or EPS is expected to be $22.50 and $24 on a non-GAAP basis.
Our expected ratio of gross margin less OpEx divided by revenue is expected to be between 41.5% and 43.5%.

guidance.value: mid- to high single digit decline
guidance.quote: we forecast overall net prices to decline by mid- to high single digits in percentage terms, including U.S. Part D changes
estimate to produce 1.6x the amount of incretin salable doses during the first half of 2025 compared to the first half of 2024

red_flags.label: Management admits 2024 shortfall vs projections
red_flags.quote: in the back half of that year -- last year, we fell short of that.

red_flags.label: Compounding and unapproved product leakage
red_flags.quote: there's no reason to have non-approved kind of illegitimate product out there

evasions.quote: I know why you're asking it. And I think the perspective we have is that it's early days on a very, very large opportunity.
As for specifics around tolerability and titration and discontinuations, those don't really factor into our thinking.
